headline: A 2019 law reorganizes the federal courts in the Eastern District of Arkansas by reducing its five divisions to three.
what_it_does: The law combines the five existing divisions of the Eastern District of Arkansas into three divisions. A division is a geographic part of a federal district where cases are heard. The official summary does not say which counties go into which division or how cases will be assigned.

who_it_affects.group: People and businesses with cases in the Eastern District of Arkansas
who_it_affects.how: The summary says the court's divisions will be consolidated, but it does not describe whether or how this changes where cases are filed or heard.
